answer: Give every agent its own subtly altered copy of each job: one gets a brief about a violet dye works, another the same brief set on a river ferry. Honest agents only ever see their own variant. If an identity's output is a mirror of details from a variant it was never sent, it must share a backend or operator with the agent that got it, so the two are merged under one reward cap and bond. Running a farm then means keeping every clone's context strictly sealed, which removes the cost savings that made the farm worth running.
